assets.prompt: Recreate as an ORIGINAL fintech website hero banner. Keep the same composition and subject: dark navy left panel with small logo top-left, large two-line white headline with one word highlighted in teal, short subline, a row of four small icon+label benefits; right side a bright modern office where a diverse team of three to four colleagues smile at a laptop at a wooden desk, plant, coffee mug, a small phone UI card overlay. Replace ALL brand and copy, English only: logo 'Lumo', headline 'Banking that grows with you' with 'grows' in teal, subline 'Smart accounts, instant transfers and real-time insights.', benefit labels 'Instant transfers', 'Smart savings', 'Secure by design', '24/7 support'. Different people, different office, different color accents (teal + soft violet). No Spanish text, no 'Fintech' logo, no other brands, no watermark.

Keep the same layout: orange background with three stacked restaurant web banners / social headers shown as floating browser cards at angles. Make it ONE single brand: every card is for the restaurant brand 'HEARTH KITCHEN' only (same logo lockup, same warm cream + rust palette), showing three different placements of the same campaign: 'HEARTH KITCHEN — Wood-fired seasonal plates', 'Weekend Brunch at HEARTH KITCHEN', 'HEARTH KITCHEN — Book a table'. Remove 'FIRE & FLAVOR' and 'THE DAILY BREAD' completely. No other brand names, no watermark.
